title: What number makes 1323 a cube number?
description: The number to multiply by is found by splitting the prime factors of one thousand three hundred twenty three into groups of three and fixing the group that is short. The new number is then checked by cubing its root, as in the solved example.
teaching_notes: One idea: a cube number has every prime factor in complete groups of three. Watch for students who multiply by the whole repeated factor instead of only the missing one.

video_script.why: The child uses groups of three prime factors to find the smallest number to multiply by to make a cube, as the solved example grouped prime factors.
video_script.substitution: Write the number as prime factors, find the group that is not full, and multiply by the missing factor.
video_script.anchor: one number card, one thousand three hundred twenty three, with a question mark beside it
video_script.payoff_line: Multiply by seven, and the new number is twenty one cubed

final_answer.spoken: multiply by seven, giving nine thousand two hundred sixty one, which is twenty one cubed

maths_rules: the 3s make one full group of three; the 7s have only two, so one more 7 is needed
video_script.design: One idea: a cube has full groups of three prime factors. The number card stays in the anchor band and the factor list sits on the working board.

narration: <bookmark mark='full'/>A cube number has its prime factors in full groups of three.
Eight is two times two times two, which is one full group.
<bookmark mark='gap'/>Four has only two twos, so a group is short.

narration: <bookmark mark='three'/>Step one, break one thousand three hundred twenty three into prime factors. Dividing by three, three times, reaches forty nine.
<bookmark mark='seven'/>Forty nine is seven times seven.
<bookmark mark='line'/>The number is three threes and two sevens.

narration: <bookmark mark='threes'/>Step two, look for full groups of three.
The threes make a full group.
<bookmark mark='sevens'/>The sevens need one more seven to make a full group.

marks.cube: the factors are grouped as (3 × 7) three times and written as 21³

narration: <bookmark mark='times'/>Step three, multiply by seven. One thousand three hundred twenty three times seven is nine thousand two hundred sixty one.
<bookmark mark='line'/>The new number has three threes and three sevens.
<bookmark mark='cube'/>Each of three equal groups holds a three and a seven, which is twenty one.

narration: <bookmark mark='back'/>Step four, put the answer back in the question.
<bookmark mark='first'/>Twenty one times twenty one is four hundred forty one.
<bookmark mark='second'/>Four hundred forty one times twenty one is nine thousand two hundred sixty one.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Multiply by seven, and the new number is twenty one cubed.
It is nine thousand two hundred sixty one.
